steps.say: For firm users, there's a faster way to get sales in than copying from M A O. The firm's weekly M A O sales export is kept on Dropbox, and the Sales Analysis tab can link to it directly, covering every municipality at once. This video shows how to connect it.
Open M A O Sales Database and click Choose export folder.
Windows opens its folder picker. Go to Dropbox, then Shared Info, App Market Data, Sales Data, and select the Manitoba folder.
The browser then asks, Allow this site to view and copy files? Click Allow. The app keeps its own copy of the sales in this browser on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.
Every municipality file imports. The status line shows how many sales were loaded and the newest sale date.

You only do this once. The folder stays connected: Reload picks up new weekly files, Disconnect forgets the folder, and Coverage shows which municipalities are in the export and how current each one is.
From here, tick the municipalities you want, pick a date range and a sale type, and search. The filters, subject property, grid and Charts then work just as they do for pasted sales.
